## Circular to Management Companies / Product Issuers of SFC-authorized Schemes

## Streamlining of Pre-vetting of Notices and Advertisements of Authorized Collective Investment Schemes

The  Commission  has  issued  a  consultation  paper  today  to  seek  comments  from  the public in respect of the proposal to streamline the pre-vetting of notices  and advertisements of collective investment schemes authorized by the Commission under the Product Codes 1 .

The consultation paper is available on our website at www.sfc.hk.  Your comments are most welcomed.

If you wish to clarify any aspects of the consultation paper, please contact your team supervisor  of  the  Investment  Products  Department  who  is  responsible  for  overseeing your schemes.

Investment Products Department Securities and Futures Commission

1 The  four  Product  Codes  are:  (1)  Code  on  Unit  Trusts  and  Mutual  Funds,  (2)  Code  on  InvestmentLinked  Assurance  Schemes,  (3)  Code  on  Pooled  Retirement  Funds  and  (4)  SFC  Code  on  MPF Products.
